verdict.rationale: Omnara documents multi-provider model support (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Bedrock, self-hosted) and organization-level model configuration and grants. Nothing in the evidence shows prompts being routed automatically to the most suitable model per task. Model selection appears to be a manual configuration choice, which is an adjacent feature rather than automatic routing.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have each task prompt automatically routed to the most suitable underlying model
